"""Independent acceptance probes; use only the disposable review database."""

import os
import uuid

import psycopg
import pytest

from agent_guard.contracts.ledger import ErrorCode, LedgerError
from agent_guard.ledger.migrate import apply_migrations
from agent_guard.ledger.service import ExecutionLedger
from tests.fixtures.state import build_tree


class RedactedDsn(str):
    def __repr__(self):
        return "<isolated-review-database>"


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def dsn():
    value = os.environ["AGENT_GUARD_TEST_DATABASE_URL"]
    with psycopg.connect(value, connect_timeout=5) as conn:
        assert conn.execute("SELECT current_database()").fetchone()[0] == "history_b_adapted"
        apply_migrations(conn)
    return RedactedDsn(value)


@pytest.fixture
def tree(dsn):
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:
        return build_tree(conn)


def test_subject_must_match_database_grant(dsn, tree):
    request = tree.invocation(subject="another-user-not-the-grant-subject")
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError) as caught:
        ExecutionLedger(dsn).accept(request, tree.cost(amount_fen=1))
    assert caught.value.code is ErrorCode.INVALID_CONTEXT


def test_one_operation_must_cost_exactly_one_call(dsn, tree):
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError) as caught:
        ExecutionLedger(dsn).accept(tree.invocation(), tree.cost(amount_fen=0, calls=2))
    assert caught.value.code is ErrorCode.INVALID_COST


def test_database_must_reject_second_root_for_same_task(dsn, tree):
    another = "review-root-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.IntegrityError):
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO ag_grants "
                "(grant_id, parent_grant_id, root_grant_id, tenant_id, task_id, subject, "
                "holder_client_id, holder_kid, depth, not_before, expires_at, "
                "amount_limit, call_limit) "
                "SELECT %s, NULL, %s, tenant_id, task_id, subject, "
                "holder_client_id, holder_kid, 0, not_before, expires_at, "
                "amount_limit, call_limit FROM ag_grants WHERE grant_id=%s",
                (another, another, tree.root_id),
            )


def test_task_root_mapping_must_not_change(dsn, tree):
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.IntegrityError):
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE ag_tasks SET root_grant_id=%s WHERE tenant_id=%s AND task_id=%s",
                ("nonexistent-replacement-root", tree.tenant_id, tree.task_id),
            )
